p1: [low, ominous] The day before Thanksgiving, nineteen seventy-one... a man in a black tie handed a flight attendant a note. [whispers] It said he had a bomb.
[low] He'd bought his ticket as Dan Cooper. Portland to Seattle. Flight three-oh-five.
[low, tense] He opened his briefcase. [whispers] Inside: red sticks... and wires.
[low] His demands: two hundred thousand dollars... and four parachutes.
[low] In Seattle, he traded the passengers for the cash and the parachutes.
[low, ominous] Then he ordered the plane back into the sky.
[low] A little after eight p.m., somewhere over the dark woods of southwest Washington... [low, tense] the rear stairs dropped open.
[whispers] He jumped. [low] Into the freezing night. In a business suit.
[low] Nine years later, a boy found rotting bundles of twenty dollar bills, buried on a riverbank.
[low] In twenty sixteen, the FBI stopped actively hunting him. [whispers] Nobody knows who he really was.
